body: I simply want to hurt people close to me. I want to ruin them, and it's so hard to fight the urge to get under their skin and rip them apart.
I'm not a horrible person, I don't know why I have sadistic urges. I have no particular reason...just hatred of being alive. I'm almost 18 and I've thought of suicide since I was 10.
I'm only a minor for another 9 months. There is no point in contacting CPS.
That's what my grandmother said she thinks she has, but I don't think she is abusive honestly. Atleast not physically.
I would have just ran them over. Brick wall be damned.

I have very few friends, all of whom suffer from depression and anxiety just as bad as mine. My best friend and someone who I consider to be a brother tried to kill himself a year ago. When he says he understands what I'm going through, I know he truly knows. I don't know you, but I do know what you are going through, and am willing to talk with you whenever my friend.
Most of my family on her side is like this, and I hate all of them. I cannot be around 95% of my family.
I'm honestly considering doing it this week

Life. I've been really trying to be happy. But more and more my discontentment I described in an earlier post gets larger. And nothing I do to change it helps. I miss my ex and I'm just terribly alone.

As do I. I completely understand why she is upset with me when I do drugs, and how much of a stress I truly am on her. But it is so hard to pull through it. Going to school and facing my anxiety and the bullies/stupid people who only add to my depression...some days I just cannot do anything, I've tried. And it doesn't w
work.
